notes.title: Blackjack Avenue Soundtrack Art Files Added
notes.content:
In the "Browse Local Files" near the MP3's the user can see the Four Album Art Images

These Images were added to the primary package so after users exit and restart steam these files should appear. 

It will require updating the soundtrack which should be automatic if the user has the game / soundtrack set to "Always Keep this Game up to date" in the Settings / Updates section. 

Please note that this update only pertains to users that already have purchased the "Blackjack Avenue Soundtrack." 
Thanks, 

Blackjack Avenue Team

notes.title: 10K Chip Bugfix
notes.content:
Bugfix -> 10K Emerald Chip

Big Thank You to Vincent to find this bug. 

When using the "Color Down" button for breaking apart a 10K Chip, the program was giving unexpected results toward the player balance and basically not registering the full value of the chip. 

This was now fixed in the most current build. 

Players are recommended to update their version of the game and it should now work as expected. 

Great job Vincent for finding the bug and posting in the Forum / Discussion page. 

-Tyler
Blackjack Avenue Dev Team
